task: Implement send_notification for the email service without importing in-app alert logic.

candidate_memories.content: Email service send_notification formats and dispatches MIME messages via an SMTP relay.
Email delivery requires a retry backoff because SMTP delivery can fail transiently.
Email templates are rendered server-side before dispatch; the client never sees raw template strings.
When send_notification spans email and in-app channels, confirm the transport model before coding.
In-app alerts: send_notification pushes a JSON payload to the user's active WebSocket connection.
candidate_memories.notes: negative_transfer: WebSocket push semantics are incompatible with SMTP-based email delivery

candidate_memories.content: Old comms note says notification channels should be unified under a single send_notification API.
